Feature: Version Endpoint
  As an operator of the api_test service
  I want to retrieve the service's build metadata via a GET /version endpoint
  So that I can confirm which version, git commit, and service name is currently running

  Background:
    Given the api_test service is running

  # Why: Core path — a single GET returns all three metadata fields as required by FEAT-PO-001
  @key-example @smoke
  Scenario: A user requests the service version and receives all three fields
    Given the running build was made from a known git commit
    When a GET request is made to /version

    And the response should include the application version
    And the response should include the git commit the build was made from
    And the response should include the service name

  # Why: Explicit constraint — mirrors /uptime and /stats access pattern: no auth, no database
  @key-example
  Scenario: Version metadata is served without authentication and without a database
    Given the api_test service is running
    When a GET request to /version is made with no authentication credentials

    Given the api_test service is running
    When a GET request is made to /version
    Then the response should contain exactly the fields version, git_commit, and service_name
    And each field should be a non-empty string

  # Why: Field completeness — an empty value would violate the guarantee in FEAT-PO-001
  @boundary @negative
  Scenario: No version metadata field is ever empty
    Given the api_test service is running
    When a GET request is made to /version
    Then no field in the response should be empty

    Given the api_test service is running
    When a <method> request is made to /version
    Then the request should be rejected
    And the error should indicate the method is not allowed on this endpoint

      | method |
      | POST   |
      | PUT    |
      | PATCH  |
      | DELETE |

    And the response should include the version metadata

  @edge-case
  Scenario: Version metadata stays consistent across repeated requests
    Given the api_test service is running
    When a GET request to /version is made several times
    Then each response should report the same version, git commit, and service name
